recipe.visualDefinition: A high-impact close-up of a tiger's eye centered in the frame, featuring a heavy radial motion blur that streaks outward from the pupil. The composition is anchored by a thin white crosshair intersecting at the iris, with aggressive, metallic-textured typography layered over the fur texture.
coreVisualRelationships: Radial blur emanating from the central eye creates a sense of speed and focus.
The warm orange and black tiger stripes contrast with the cool metallic silver of the text.
The horizontal crosshair line stabilizes the chaotic motion of the background fur.
coreInvariants: Centralized tiger eye as the focal point
Metallic bevel and drop shadow on primary text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The tiger's eye is perfectly centered, scaled to occupy the middle third of the vertical axis.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The yellow-gold iris of the tiger.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye draws the viewer inward, while the radial blur pushes the gaze outward toward the text at the top and bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is filled with textured fur and motion streaks.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm orange and amber (fur and iris)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Metallic silver and white (text and crosshair)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the center iris, fading into blurred mid-tones at the edges.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Angular, geometric sans-serif with sharp terminals
letterConstructionRules: Sharp, pointed serifs or spurs on the ends of strokes
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'S' and 'R' feature elongated, lightning-bolt-like diagonal strokes.
The 'V' is deep and sharp, mirroring the angle of the surrounding letters.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Aggressive custom display type paired with a traditional high-contrast serif for readability.
graphicDevices: Outer red glow on main title

preserve: Angular nature of the main title
avoid: Bright neon colors other than orange

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the sharp, aggressive rock aesthetic of the main title.
Provides the necessary contrast for the tracklist information.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a macro photograph of a tiger's eye centered in the frame. Apply a heavy radial zoom blur effect starting from the pupil and moving outward. Add a very thin, semi-transparent white horizontal line and a shorter vertical line intersecting at the center of the pupil like a crosshair.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place the main title in the upper third using a sharp, angular, metallic-textured font with a red outer glow. Place the tracklist in the lower third using a clean, bold serif font in white with a subtle drop shadow for legibility.

verificationChecks: Is the eye the central focal point?
Does the radial blur feel like it is moving toward the viewer?
Is the main title text beveled and metallic?
Are the crosshair lines thin and precise?

adjustableVariables: Color of the iris (gold vs green)
Thickness of the metallic bevel on the text

mustAchieve: Clear hierarchy between title and list

postGenerationChecks: Check for text legibility against the blurred background.
Ensure the radial blur does not obscure the iris detail.
Verify the metallic texture looks like brushed steel or chrome.
Confirm the crosshair is perfectly centered on the pupil.
recipe.reuseFormula: Central animal eye + radial zoom blur + thin crosshair + angular metallic display type = Aggressive Rock Aesthetic.
